free_tier_limits.correction: Free public access has documented operational constraints: point requests allow at most 20 parameters, regional requests one parameter, and redundant requests may be blocked.

rate_limits.correction: NASA documents HTTP 429 rate limiting, warns that excessive synchronous requests may be blocked, and advises no more than five concurrent requests; no per-minute quota is stated.

notes: Current OpenAPI v2.9.6 confirms the unauthenticated GET endpoint and request structure. The entry fails because documented request constraints and rate-limiting guidance contradict “unknown” and “not published.” CORS was not documented and could not be established.
